# OpenThesis 1.0.4

## English

- Parallel base-agent execution is now **off by default** to avoid provider timeout failures.
- Users can still enable parallel execution from the model configuration when their provider and network support it.
- Preserves per-agent progress, cancellation acknowledgement, and configurable request timeouts.
- Windows portable ZIP is built without an installer or visible console window.

## 简体中文

- 基础 Agent 并行执行现在默认关闭，降低模型接口超时风险。
- 如果模型供应商和网络环境稳定，用户仍可在模型配置中手动开启并行执行。
- 保留逐 Agent 进度、取消确认和可配置请求超时功能。
- Windows 便携 ZIP 解压即可运行，无需安装，也不会弹出命令行窗口。

本项目仅用于长期公司研究，不提供交易执行或短线预测功能。
